# Orange Sound Guild

> Orange Sound Guild is a music streaming web app for uploading, discovering, and playing audio tracks from independent artists.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Latest tracks and featured artists.
- [Top 100](/top100): The 100 most-played tracks right now.
- [Search](/search): Find artists, tracks and genres.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in to save playlists, follow artists, and upload.
